post.summary: Build the Evidence Passport for a supplied analysis
post.description: Deterministically cites the M1/M2/M3/M5 results in the supplied AnalysisBundle. Every upstream value carries the exact field_path it was copied from. Missing data is reported, never filled in.

post.summary: Detect missing or incomplete evidence in a supplied analysis
post.description: Deterministic rules over the supplied AnalysisBundle. Reports what is missing and who can supply it; never fills in a value. Uses the same detector as /evidence, so both endpoints report identical blind spots. module_status always contains M1, M2, M3 and M5.

post.summary: Answer a question about a supplied analysis, grounded in its evidence
post.description: Answers only from the Evidence Passport and blind spots built from the supplied AnalysisBundle. Template answers by default; use_llm=true lets an optional LLM (configured by environment variables) rephrase the template answer, falling back to the template on any problem. Every number in an answer must come from the cited evidence. Questions about yields, money, input doses, quantified soil improvement or crop choice are refused.

post.summary: Run the full CropCompass analysis for a farm in one call
post.description: Calls M1 (climate), M2 (rotation, alternatives, suitability for every crop), M3 and M5 when implemented, then builds the Evidence Passport and Blind-Spot Report. A failing or slow module is reported as unavailable and the analysis continues; only invalid input returns 4xx. The returned `bundle` can be sent unchanged to /evidence, /blind-spots and /assistant.
